## Code Review

This pull request introduces support for handling and saving Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) weights omitted by Transformers, allowing them to be copied, dequantized, or quantized during model saving. It also adds fusion patterns for Nemotron MTP, Transformers MLA, and MoE architectures. The review feedback highlights several robustness improvements, including a critical fix to prevent main model weights from being omitted from the safetensors index when saving non-sharded models, as well as safety guards against potential AttributeErrors, StopIteration exceptions, and TypeErrors in configuration parsing.
